answerUz: Siz 3‑shaxs birlik va odatiy harakat bo‘yicha xatolar qilgansiz. Quyidagi 3 ta yangi mashq bu nuqtalarni mustahkamlashga yordam beradi.

questions.question: He ___ (watch) TV every evening.
questions.explanationUz: 3‑shaxs birlikda fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi, shuning uchun "watches" to‘g‘ri.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly shows a habitual action?
options: She goes to the gym on Mondays.
She went to the gym on Monday.
She is going to the gym on Monday.
She will go to the gym on Monday.
questions.explanationUz: Odatiy harakat doimiy ravishda sodir bo‘lganda Present Simple ishlatiladi; "She goes to the gym on Mondays." bu holatga mos.

questions.question: Fill in the blank with the correct Present Simple form: "My brother ___ (play) the piano, but he ___ (like) jazz music."
questions.skillUz: Present Simple – birinchi shaxs birlik & 3‑shaxs birlik kombinatsiyasi
questions.explanationUz: Birinchi fe’l "play" 3‑shaxs birlikda "plays" bo‘ladi, ikkinchi fe’l "like" ham 3‑shaxs birlikda "likes" bo‘ladi, shuning uchun "plays / likes" to‘g‘ri.
